breakdown.description: The pressure field is floating because no reference pressure is set. For an incompressible simulation to converge, pressure must be fixed at least at one point, typically the outlet, with a `fixedValue` condition. Setting all pressure boundaries to `zeroGradient` will lead to a solver failure.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the pressure field was floating because no reference pressure was set. It corrected the `outlet` boundary condition from `zeroGradient` to `fixedValue` with a value of `uniform 0`, which provides the necessary pressure reference for the solver to converge. This matches the correction in the ground truth.
